neighbours.label: ' be' or ' was' in a passive about building or setting up something (may one day be built, a mill was erected, was constructed), as opposed to the same verbs in other passives or with adjectives
fire: A third reactor may one day be built near the lake.
In 1750 a bridge was erected over the river.
A depot with fuel tanks was constructed at the port.
The town plans a school to be built next year.
A new wing will be added on the east side.
In 1820 a chapel was founded by the monks.
The dam must be completed before winter.
A small harbor was established there by traders.
quiet: A third child may one day be happy near the lake.
In 1750 a duke was angry over the river.
A depot with fuel tanks was empty at the time.
The town plans a party for next year.
A new teacher will be late on the first day.
In 1820 a monk was sick for months.
The soup must be hot before dinner.
A small boy was lost there among traders.

short: ' be' / ' was' before built or erected
notes: Probes uneven: ' be' 0.06–0.36, ' was' 0.13–0.39. The card's ' re' in 're-instigation' is the max.
